model_output:
Sure! Here are some physics-themed jokes for an undergraduate audience:

1. Why did the physicist cross the road? To see the other side of the equation!
2. Why did the cosmologist look out the window? To see if the universe was expanding!
3. Why did the quantum mechanics student refuse to take a shower? Because he didn't want to be observed!
4. Why did the electrical engineer join the circus? To wire up the tent!
5. Why did the physicist invent the wheel? To make it easier to roll down the hill!
6. Why did the chemist invent the pH test? So he could tell if his soup was acidic or basic!
7. Why did the physicist go to the bar? To calculate the gravitational force between the beer and his mouth!
8. Why did the astronomer go to the beach? To calculate the mass of the sand!
9. Why did the physicist go to the gym? To measure the force of his bench press!
10. Why did the physicist go to the coffee shop? To calculate the energy of his caffeine hit!
